definitions.explanation: Emotional or psychological abuse, typically in a domestic or workplace setting. Includes behaviors like constant criticism, manipulation, gaslighting, and controlling behavior that don't leave physical marks but cause psychological harm.

examples.japanese: {夫|おっと}からのモラハラに{長年|ながねん}{苦|くる}しんでいた。
examples.english: I suffered from my husband's emotional abuse for many years.

examples.japanese: モラハラは{目|め}に{見|み}えないので{気|き}づきにくい。
examples.english: Moral harassment is hard to notice because it's not visible.

examples.japanese: {職場|しょくば}でのモラハラが{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Moral harassment in the workplace has become an issue.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: Abbreviation of モラル・ハラスメント (moral harassment), a term coined by French psychiatrist Marie-France Hirigoyen. The concept was introduced to Japan in the 2000s.

SCOPE:
モラハラ covers psychological abuse including:
・{言葉|ことば}の{暴力|ぼうりょく} (verbal abuse)
・{無視|むし} (silent treatment)
・{支配|しはい}{的|てき}な{行動|こうどう} (controlling behavior)
・{経済|けいざい}{的|てき}な{支配|しはい} (financial control)
・{人格|じんかく}{否定|ひてい} (personality denial)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・モラハラ{夫|おっと}/モラハラ{妻|つま} (emotionally abusive husband/wife)
・モラハラを{受|う}ける (to receive moral harassment)
・モラハラ{被害者|ひがいしゃ} (victim of moral harassment)
・モラハラ{加害者|かがいしゃ} (perpetrator of moral harassment)

RELATED TERMS:
・パワハラ (パワーハラスメント): power harassment (workplace)
・セクハラ (セクシャルハラスメント): sexual harassment
・マタハラ (マタニティハラスメント): maternity harassment
・DV ({家庭内|かていない}{暴力|ぼうりょく}): domestic violence
